name: Santomera (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and green with a yellow triangle with its base along the hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santomera (a tree, a hand and lemons on white).
history: Municipal flag of Santomera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
